raw_response: {"diagnosis": "raw_transactions contains 28 record_version=2 rows that are re-delivered copies of existing txn_ids (4975 distinct ids across 5003 rows). The silver step keeps every version and only filters on status, so superseded versions survive and produce duplicate txn_ids. Keeping the latest record_version per txn_id before applying the POSTED filter should give one authoritative row per transaction.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.6, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM (SELECT * FROM raw_transactions QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY txn_id ORDER BY record_version DESC, ingest_ts DESC) = 1) latest WHERE status = 'POSTED';"}}
